description: Move a deal forward. stage 'sent' + replyUrl (the URL of the reply the user posted on X) records the reply and awards Stars; it must be the user's own reply, not the founder's post. Later stages are private pipeline steps: 'replied' (the founder answered), 'call_booked', 'closed_won', 'lost'. Free. Only report what the user tells you happened.
